topology_edges.conditional_mechanism: If economic data strength is observed, then the monetary policy cut debate is contextualized.
If the monetary policy cut debate is active, then Treasury market performance is contextualized.
If QT and yield curve expectations are present, then Treasury market performance may be influenced.
If Treasury market performance is observed, then the net real-yield move is influenced, contingent on inflation compensation.
If inflation compensation is encoded by nominal and TIPS yields, then the net real-yield move is interpreted.
If the net real-yield move determinants are observed, then the target metric is influenced.
